checks.explanation: D-selection is on page 1, the same page as the start of the itemized prices, which counts as placed correctly.
The basic services includesText names arrangements conference, planning, consulting with family and clergy, shelter of remains, notices, permits, and coordination with third parties.
No other mandatory fee for services, facilities or overhead is listed besides the basic services fee.
No D-embalming disclosure text appears in the transcribed list.
No text states embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket service.
D-alt-container is on page 2, the same page as the direct cremation range, which counts as placed correctly.
Direct cremation offers an option with container provided by the purchaser and no text says a casket is required.
The direct cremation description mentions cremation but no separate crematory cash-advance charge is shown to create ambiguity.
Forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial each have itemized prices and no package-only or description-only item is shown.
No optional combination package is offered; forwarding, receiving, direct cremation and immediate burial are not packages.
No text asserts that law, a cemetery or a crematory requires a purchase beyond the wording of required disclosures.
No text claims goods or services delay decomposition or protect from gravesite substances.
No other wording undercuts a required disclosure, and the unfilled blank in D-alt-container alone is not a concern for this check.
